method.population: the 245 paths listed in the parent index. This node re-classified that population; it did not re-derive the scope.
method.principle: A file is DERIVED only when something that actually produces it can be named. Extension, shape, and vocabulary are not evidence.

evidence_channels.WRITE_SITE: an AST-resolved write of this exact path in a .py (open(...,'w'|'a'|'x'), write_text/write_bytes, to_parquet/to_csv/to_json, pq.write_table, Path(...).open('w'), or a call to a writer-helper function discovered in the corpus). A bare filename target is credited only to a file in the writing script's own directory.
evidence_channels.WRITE_SITE_WILDCARD: same, where the directory part of the path expression was not statically resolvable. Matched as a glob under a locality rule (the writing script must live in a directory containing the target, or the target must have a rooted prefix) and the target must still name a concrete file. Marked confidence=probable. A test-fixture writer alone never forces DERIVED; it is recorded in not_established.
evidence_channels.TEMPLATE_EMIT: two or more distinct lines of the document (>=45 chars) appear verbatim as string literals in ONE .py whose write scope covers the path. This is what identifies generators whose output path is data-driven -- the 57 node prompts, for instance.
evidence_channels.SELF_DECLARED: a generation marker in the file's OWN bytes that survives a REFERENT TEST. For .md: markers inside fenced code blocks are ignored; a marker naming a DIFFERENT file is rejected; an explicit self-anchor ('this file is generated ...') is accepted regardless of what source it names; the weak verbs emitted/written/produced-by count only when the sentence names this file. For .json: only TOP-LEVEL declaration keys count. For .py: only the module docstring counts, because a marker in a string literal is the script EMITTING that text into something else.
evidence_channels.RENDERED_FROM: a .md that reproduces >=90%% of the sha256 digests carried by a same-stem indexed .json is a rendering of it. This is how the self-reference case is settled.

method.decision_rule: DERIVED iff at least one channel fires AND a generator can be named. HAND_MAINTAINED iff every channel comes back empty. No record was left UNDETERMINED.
method.write_discipline_field: DERIVED files whose only write site is an append are marked APPEND_ONLY_NOT_REGENERABLE. 'DERIVED' must not be read as 'safe to regenerate' for those -- an append-only ledger is machine-written and irreplaceable, which is the same class of hazard this remediation exists to remove.

"""Prove the write-scanner works before trusting any negative it reports.

Positive controls  : files the program self-evidently generates must be FOUND.
Injected fixtures  : synthetic writers of files the scan reports as unwritten
                     must be FOUND, in every syntactic form the real code uses.
Returns 1 on any failure.
"""
import json, os, sys, tempfile, importlib.util

HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("writescan", os.path.join(HERE, "writescan.py"))
ws = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(ws)

FIXTURES = {
    "f_const.py": 'open("experiments/player_program/RESEARCH_CONTRACT_V1.md", "w").write("x")\n',
    "f_var.py": (
        'OUT = "experiments/player_program/RESEARCH_CONTRACT_V1.md"\n'
        'with open(OUT, "w", encoding="utf-8") as fh:\n    fh.write("x")\n'
    ),
    "f_path.py": (
        'from pathlib import Path\n'
        'ROOT = Path("experiments/player_program")\n'
        'p = ROOT / "orchestration" / "GRAPH_POLICY.md"\n'
        'p.write_text("x", encoding="utf-8")\n'
    ),
    "f_join.py": (
        'import os, json\n'
        'D = "experiments/player_program"\n'
        'with open(os.path.join(D, "README.md"), "w") as f:\n    json.dump({}, f)\n'
    ),
    "f_fstring.py": (
        'D = "experiments/player_program"\n'
        'open(f"{D}/RESEARCH_CONTRACT_V1.md", "w").write("x")\n'
    ),
    "f_pathopen.py": (
        'from pathlib import Path\n'
        'Path("HANDOFF_TURNOVER_DISCOVERY.md").open("w").write("x")\n'
    ),
    "f_parquet.py": (
        'df = None\n'
        'df.to_parquet("experiments/player_program/possessions_v1/possessions.parquet")\n'
    ),
}

# (indexed path, must appear among the resolved write targets of the real tree)
NEGATIVE_CONTROLS = [
    "experiments/player_program/RESEARCH_CONTRACT_V1.md",
    "experiments/player_program/orchestration/GRAPH_POLICY.md",
    "experiments/player_program/README.md",
    "experiments/player_program/orchestration/README.md",
    "HANDOFF_PLAYER_MODEL_PROGRAM.md",
    "HANDOFF_TURNOVER_DISCOVERY.md",
    "HANDOFF_ADDENDUM_INTEGRITY_WORK.md",
]

POSITIVE_CONTROLS = [
    "experiments/player_program/orchestration/reports/CURRENT_STATUS.md",
    "experiments/player_program/orchestration/GRAPH_STATE.json",
]


def basenames_of(hits):
    out = set()
    for site in hits:
        t = site[0] if isinstance(site, tuple) else site["target"]
        if isinstance(t, str) and not t.startswith("PARSE_ERROR"):
            out.add(t.rsplit("/", 1)[-1])
    return out


def main():
    fail = []

    # ---- 1. injected fixtures -------------------------------------------
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as td:
        for name, src in FIXTURES.items():
            p = os.path.join(td, name)
            open(p, "w", encoding="utf-8").write(src)
            files = {p: ws.parse(p)}
            menv = {os.path.splitext(name)[0]: ws.module_constants(p, files[p][1], files[p][0], {})}
            hits = ws.scan(files, menv, ws.find_writer_helpers(files)).get(
                ws.norm(os.path.relpath(p, ws.ROOT)), [])
            bn = basenames_of(hits)
            want = src.split('"')[1::2]
            wanted_bn = {w.rsplit("/", 1)[-1] for w in want if "." in w.rsplit("/", 1)[-1]}
            wanted_bn = {w for w in wanted_bn if w.endswith((".md", ".json", ".parquet"))}
            if not wanted_bn & bn:
                fail.append(f"FIXTURE {name}: expected one of {sorted(wanted_bn)}, scanner saw {sorted(bn)}")
            else:
                print(f"  ok  fixture {name:16s} -> {sorted(bn & wanted_bn)}")

    # ---- 2. positive controls in the real tree --------------------------
    sites = json.load(open(os.path.join(HERE, "write_sites.json"), encoding="utf-8"))["write_sites"]
    all_targets = []
    for script, hs in sites.items():
        for h in hs:
            if isinstance(h["target"], str):
                all_targets.append((script, h["target"], h["line"]))
    for ctl in POSITIVE_CONTROLS:
        bn = ctl.rsplit("/", 1)[-1]
        found = [(s, t, l) for s, t, l in all_targets if t.rsplit("/", 1)[-1] == bn]
        if not found:
            fail.append(f"POSITIVE CONTROL not found: {ctl}")
        else:
            print(f"  ok  control {bn:24s} written by {found[0][0]}:{found[0][2]}")

    # ---- 3. the prompts corpus: 57 generated prompts, one generator ------
    gp = "experiments/player_program/orchestration/scripts/generate_prompts.py"
    gp_sites = sites.get(gp, [])
    if not gp_sites:
        fail.append("POSITIVE CONTROL: generate_prompts.py has no write site at all")
    else:
        print(f"  ok  generate_prompts.py writes {[h['target'] for h in gp_sites]} "
              f"(path is data-driven from PROGRAM_GRAPH.json, so it resolves to a wildcard "
              f"under the worktree root -- the prompt<->generator link is carried by the "
              f"TEMPLATE_EMIT channel, tested in selftest_classify.py)")

    # ---- 3b. negative controls: independent raw-byte grep of every .py -------
    import re as _re
    for neg in NEGATIVE_CONTROLS:
        bn = neg.rsplit("/", 1)[-1]
        ast_hits = [(s_, t, l) for s_, t, l in all_targets if t.rsplit("/", 1)[-1] == bn]
        grep = []
        for dp, dn, fn in os.walk(ws.ROOT):
            if ".git" in dp.split(os.sep) or "__pycache__" in dp:
                continue
            for f in fn:
                if not f.endswith(".py"):
                    continue
                fp = os.path.join(dp, f)
                try:
                    txt = open(fp, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace").read()
                except Exception:
                    continue
                for m in _re.finditer(_re.escape(bn), txt):
                    ln = txt.count(chr(10), 0, m.start()) + 1
                    grep.append((ws.norm(os.path.relpath(fp, ws.ROOT)), ln,
                                 txt.splitlines()[ln - 1].strip()[:120]))
        print(f"  neg  {bn:32s} ast_write_hits={len(ast_hits)}  raw_byte_mentions={len(grep)}")
        for g in grep[:6]:
            print(f"        mention {g[0]}:{g[1]}  {g[2]}")
        if ast_hits:
            print(f"        !! AST says written by {ast_hits}")

    # ---- 4. parse errors must be visible, not swallowed ------------------
    perr = list(json.load(open(os.path.join(HERE, "write_sites.json"), encoding="utf-8"))["parse_errors"].items())
    print(f"  info parse errors: {len(perr)}")
    for s, e in perr:
        print(f"       {s}: {str(e)[:90]}")

    print()
    if fail:
        for f in fail:
            print("FAIL:", f)
        return 1
    print("ALL SCANNER SELF-TESTS PASSED")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

"""Prove the referent test -- the rule the parent index got wrong.

The parent classified RESEARCH_CONTRACT_V1.md as DERIVED because the file contains
the sentence "`PROGRAM_STATE.json` is derived, never hand-edited. Re-run the
generator." That sentence is about PROGRAM_STATE.json. A marker only counts as a
self-declaration when it is about the file that contains it.

Fixtures below encode that distinction, in both directions, so a passing run means
the classifier can tell "I am generated" from "that other file is generated".
Returns 1 on any failure.
"""
import importlib.util, json, os, sys, tempfile

HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("classify", os.path.join(HERE, "classify.py"))
C = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(C)

# (name, ext, bytes, expect_self_declared)
FIXTURES = [
    ("about_another_file.md", ".md",
     "# A hand-written contract\n\n"
     "`PROGRAM_STATE.json` is **derived, never hand-edited**. Re-run the generator.\n",
     False),
    ("about_another_file_table.md", ".md",
     "# Policy\n\n| file | kind |\n|---|---|\n"
     "| `GRAPH_STATE.json` | generated current snapshot, derived, never hand-edited |\n",
     False),
    ("about_itself.md", ".md",
     "# Node prompt\n\n> This file is GENERATED from the node's contract in `PROGRAM_GRAPH.json`.\n",
     True),
    ("names_itself.md", ".md",
     "# Matrix\n\nbody\n\n*Generated by `build_final_matrix.py` into `names_itself.md`.*\n",
     True),
    ("quotes_code.md", ".md",
     "# Notes\n\n```\nL.append(\"Generated by scripts/graphctl.py status\")\n```\n",
     False),
    ("weak_prose.md", ".md",
     "# Gate\n\nA fact produced by the challenger's code path is not a control.\n",
     False),
]

JSON_FIXTURES = [
    ("nested_marker.json", {"schema": "x/1", "checks": [
        {"detail": "CURRENT_STATUS.md declares itself generated from PROGRAM_GRAPH.json"}]}, False),
    ("schema_key_only.json", {"schema": "x/1", "rows": 5}, False),
    ("top_level_decl.json", {"schema": "x/1",
                             "derived_not_maintained": "re-run build_program_state.py"}, True),
    ("top_level_generator.json", {"generated_by": "scripts/graphctl.py ownership"}, True),
]

PY_FIXTURES = [
    ("emits_marker.py", 'def f():\n    return "Generated by `me.py`. Do not hand-edit."\n', False),
    ("declares_in_docstring.py", '"""Auto-generated from the schema. Do not hand-edit."""\nx = 1\n', True),
]

# real files whose corrected classification the node's acceptance criteria name
EXPECT_REAL = {
    "experiments/player_program/RESEARCH_CONTRACT_V1.md": "HAND_MAINTAINED",
    "experiments/player_program/orchestration/GRAPH_POLICY.md": "HAND_MAINTAINED",
    "experiments/player_program/README.md": "HAND_MAINTAINED",
    "experiments/player_program/orchestration/README.md": "HAND_MAINTAINED",
    "HANDOFF_PLAYER_MODEL_PROGRAM.md": "HAND_MAINTAINED",
    "HANDOFF_TURNOVER_DISCOVERY.md": "HAND_MAINTAINED",
    "HANDOFF_ADDENDUM_INTEGRITY_WORK.md": "HAND_MAINTAINED",
    "experiments/player_program/orchestration/reports/DOCUMENT_INDEX.json": "DERIVED",
    "experiments/player_program/orchestration/reports/DOCUMENT_INDEX.md": "DERIVED",
    # right answer in the parent index, but reached by quoting a sentence about
    # STATE_INDEX.json; here it must be reached from an actual write site
    "experiments/player_program/data_lane/D11_LIVE_INFORMATION_CAPTURE/ledger/README.md": "DERIVED",
}


def main():
    fail = []
    root_saved = C.ROOT
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as td:
        C.ROOT = td.replace("\\", "/")
        for name, ext, body, want in FIXTURES:
            open(os.path.join(td, name), "w", encoding="utf-8").write(body)
            acc, rej = C.self_declaration(name, body, ext)
            got = bool(acc)
            tag = "ok " if got == want else "FAIL"
            print(f"  {tag} md   {name:28s} self_declared={got} (want {want})"
                  + (f"  rejected_because={rej[0].get('referent', rej[0].get('where'))!r}"
                     if not got and rej else ""))
            if got != want:
                fail.append(f"{name}: self_declared={got}, want {want}")

        for name, obj, want in JSON_FIXTURES:
            p = os.path.join(td, name)
            json.dump(obj, open(p, "w", encoding="utf-8"))
            body = open(p, encoding="utf-8").read()
            acc, rej = C.self_declaration(name, body, ".json")
            got = bool(acc)
            tag = "ok " if got == want else "FAIL"
            print(f"  {tag} json {name:28s} self_declared={got} (want {want})")
            if got != want:
                fail.append(f"{name}: self_declared={got}, want {want}")

        for name, body, want in PY_FIXTURES:
            open(os.path.join(td, name), "w", encoding="utf-8").write(body)
            acc, rej = C.self_declaration(name, body, ".py")
            got = bool(acc)
            tag = "ok " if got == want else "FAIL"
            print(f"  {tag} py   {name:28s} self_declared={got} (want {want})")
            if got != want:
                fail.append(f"{name}: self_declared={got}, want {want}")
    C.ROOT = root_saved

    print()
    recs = {r["path"]: r for r in
            json.load(open(os.path.join(HERE, "classified.json"), encoding="utf-8"))["records"]}
    for path, want in EXPECT_REAL.items():
        got = recs.get(path, {}).get("maintenance")
        tag = "ok " if got == want else "FAIL"
        print(f"  {tag} real {path[:62]:62s} {got} (want {want})")
        if got != want:
            fail.append(f"{path}: {got}, want {want}")

    # every DERIVED record must name a generator -- the acceptance criterion
    unnamed = [r["path"] for r in recs.values()
               if r["maintenance"] == "DERIVED" and not r["generator"]]
    print(f"\n  {'ok ' if not unnamed else 'FAIL'} every DERIVED record names a generator "
          f"({len(unnamed)} without)")
    if unnamed:
        fail.append(f"DERIVED without generator: {unnamed[:5]}")

    print()
    if fail:
        for f in fail:
            print("FAIL:", f)
        return 1
    print("ALL CLASSIFIER SELF-TESTS PASSED")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
